notes.title: Halloween update! Demo 2.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're a couple days late, but our Halloween update is now out!
It introduces a completely new mission for the occasion, as well as a variety of bug fixes and QoL tweaks.

We hope you enjoy, let us know what you think!

notes.title: Minor Update: Demo 1.4.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for trying out our modest demo. In the future, the content of the demo will increase while we develop what's left of the full game - but for now, we're updating with some small quality of life changes and one new feature:

 Introducing HD mode: Under Options -> Video you'll now find the HD Game View option. This will display the game without pixelation; please note that text and other elements may look slightly distorted as the game is not intended to be viewed with this resolution.
 Added a small time window (0.4s) during which turning left/right with tank controls and dodging will dodge you sideways relative to the original orientation before dodging. This should hopefully not prevent anyone in dodging how they actually want to, and help those people who pressed dodge with some delay to make sure they wouldn't just dodge backwards.
 Added an effect to indicate a shot is as charged up as possible.
 When "Flick Auto Aim" is on, you will now only switch targets if you tap left/right while aiming. Holding for longer than 0.15s will let you rotate freely.
 Potential menu button mouse hitbox bugs should be fixed now.
 Mouse cursor will disappear after 2s of not moving it.


Keep killing demons and stay tuned for more updates!
